text:
alyssa: deploy-bot just prevented the cut for release v2026-03-21 because `manifest-list` digests don't line up between canary registry and origin. preflight failed and the promote is on hold.

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion blocked: manifest-list-digest-mismatch for registry.prod/release/v2026-03-21. preflight job `preflight-e2e-7` aborted after health-checks failed. logs: https://ci.redwood/integration/1799801234/logs

mike: saw a 409 during manifest put last night, likely a re-annotate race where two pipelines pushed different schema versions. can we inspect the manifest list and the referenced platform manifests?

sre-oncall: I pulled the manifests off the registry. manifest-list annotations differ: one references linux/amd64 sha256:efef1111, other references sha256:bbbb2222. Both exist in storage but sizes differ. I can temporarily mark the newer manifest as quarantined while we decide.

lee: if both blobs exist we could set the promotion to use the explicit platform manifest digests instead of the list, but that makes the rollout brittle. My suggestion: pin to the platform manifest that passed smoke last night (sha256:efef1111) and re-run preflight with node affinity to avoid cross-region cache issues.

ops-jen: caution: previous pinning caused an outage when a regional cache served a different blob. we need to ensure regional registry caches are consistent. SRE, can you force replication and then we verify checksums from at least three regions?

sre-oncall: yep. kicking off async replication check across us-west1/eu-west1/ap-southeast1. ETA ~10m. tagging suspect manifest as quarantined: manifest:sha256:bbbb2222 -> quarantined_by:sre-oncall

mike: command to pin (dry run):
```bash
# fetch last-green platform manifest
curl -sS https://registry.prod/v2/release/v2026-03-21/manifests | jq '.platforms[] | select(.annotations."redwood/last-green"=="true")'
# promote explicit platform manifest
deployctl promote --repo prod --platform-digest sha256:efef1111 --reason "pin platform manifest after manifest-list mismatch"
```

alyssa: vote: pin to efef1111 if replication confirms availability. also add a temporary gate: disable automated canary rollouts for this promo and require manual enable after verification.

deploy-bot: [automated] Manual promotion requested by mike. queued: promote --repo prod --platform-digest sha256:efef1111 --requester mike

mike: running promotion now and will run post-promote `deployctl verify-regions` to curl image manifests from three regions.

sre-oncall: replication check: us-west1 and eu-west1 OK (manifest and blob sizes match efef1111). ap-southeast1 lagging but fetchable (replication fine after manual retry). quarantine applied to bbbb2222.

ops-jen: good. I'll prepare a short release note: "Promotion delayed briefly for artifact consistency checks; pinned to last-known-good platform manifest and verification completed."

lee: I'll trigger preflight-e2e-7 rerun with platform-digest pinned and extended timeouts. If it passes, we manually flip canary and watch for 20m then full rollout. If it fails, fallback is to rollback to tag `stable-2026-03-20` and open rollback playbook.

mike: preflight rerun kicked off. logs: https://ci.redwood/integration/1799801234/rerun. bumped timeout to 50m and constrained runner pool to us-west1 to reduce cross-region flakiness.

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight-e2e-7 rerun started by lee (priority: high).

sre-oncall: replication stabilization complete. monitoring registry error rates for any anomalous 5xxs.

alyssa: thumbs up. decision: pin to sha256:efef1111, quarantine sha256:bbbb2222, rerun preflight, manual canary enable after verification window. will file a post-mortem and a ticket for the upload pipeline owners to add stricter atomicity on manifest writes. :thumbsup:

mike: update - preflight passed basic health checks at 2026-03-21T16:20Z. leaving canary disabled until 16:35Z for manual enable.

ops-jen: publishing short release note to #release-notes and customer-facing status.

deploy-bot: [automated] Promotion ready for manual proceed. state: pinned platform-digest=sha256:efef1111, quarantined=sha256:bbbb2222, preflight=passed.

alyssa: final ops plan: manual canary at 16:35Z, monitor 20m, then finalize. creating follow-up ticket for upload pipeline investigation. closing hold. :white_check_mark:
